messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "follow instructions on pack exactly"
set: ["follow instructions on pack exactly", "follow doctor's instructions", "always follow doctor's instructions", "follow all storage instructions provided", "follow doctor's instructions very closely", "carefully follow your doctor's instructions", "follow doctor's instructions during pregnancy", "follow all dosing instructions very carefully", "carefully follow instructions about adjusting dose", "follow all medication instructions very carefully", "follow doctor's dosing instructions very carefully", "follow doctor's instructions about tapering dose", "follow all instructions of your doctor or dietitian", "follow doctor's instructions if pregnant or become pregnant", "check the instructions on the label", "follow all directions on prescription label"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
